title: Lost back up, no updates, slow development
body: This has become from the best habits app I’ve used to the, sadly, most unused one. Also somehow my back up failed and now I lost all my data. Slow updates on apps, no Apple Watch complications, many other things. Could easily be top 5 habit app worldwide, guess company has other priorities.
author: DeniTech

title: Today knappe App
body:

author: Liammeke

title: Great motivator
body: Excellent app to get you motivated, to remind you of the things you should do, but not like a reminder app.
author: PhillLD
